topic: Someone discovers a hidden room in their new house
text: Finding a hidden room in this old house, I suppose, is supposed to be a thrilling discovery. An unexpected bonus, they say. But as I stand here, in the dim light filtering through a crack in the wall, the only thing that feels real is the chill that seeps into my bones. This room carries whispers of the past, secrets locked away, and now, here I stand, the accidental keeper of forgotten things. The walls, old and tired, echo with silence, and the air is thick with the scent of aged wood and dust. I should feel excited, intrigued, but all I can think about is how this hidden space has been alone for so long. Just like me.
